user.title: Select Danfoss Ally rooms
user.description: The integration detects ZHA Danfoss eTRV0103 valves from Home Assistant areas. Verify that every selected area represents one real heated room.

data.max_sensor_age_minutes: Maximum age of a temperature value

data_description.areas: Only selected areas are monitored. Areas without a matching ZHA Danfoss thermostat are omitted.
data_description.enabled: When off, the integration calculates and displays mean/window state but never writes thermostat values.
data_description.max_sensor_age_minutes: Sensors that have not reported for longer, or are unavailable or non-numeric, are excluded from the mean.
data_description.sync_temperature: The cadence follows each valve's covered-radiator mode (read-only): every 5–25 minutes when covered, 30 minutes to 2¾ hours when exposed.
data_description.sync_windows: Any available open contact opens the room; unavailable contacts are ignored. Required for valve-window sharing.
data_description.sync_valve_windows: When one valve detects an open window itself, all valves in the area close. Valves in covered-radiator mode do not detect windows themselves.
data_description.excluded_entities: Same as the source switches on each room device: these sensors or contacts stay listed but are not used, for example a motion sensor's phantom opening entity.
data_description.aggregation: Median ignores a single outlier, such as a sensor near a radiator; mean averages all fresh sensors.
data_description.startup_delay_minutes: No valve is written until this time has passed after a restart, so the Zigbee network can re-form. Temperature sensors are only used again once they have reported after the restart.
data_description.heat_source: Optional: a binary sensor that is on while the heating system supplies heat, for example the ECL Comfort 310's 'Heat available'. It is forwarded to every coordinated valve as HeatAvailable (Danfoss catalogue §2.7): without heat the valves switch to boiler mode and stop requesting heat the system is not supplying. Empty = not used.
data_description.adaptation_with_heat: The valves' own nightly adaptation run is switched off. Instead the coordinator starts it once the heat source has reported heat for 30 minutes - only on valves that have not learned their valve characteristic and are not running one (Danfoss catalogue §1.6). Needs 'Heat available from'.
data_description.demand_climates: Thermostats (e.g. floor heating) whose action 'heating' counts as room demand in the house sensors. The house sensors only report; nothing is switched by them.
data_description.exercise_day: All coordinated valves exercise (move once to prevent sticking, catalogue §3.7) on this day, staggered by 10 minutes from the start time. 'Off' leaves the valves' own setting.
data_description.exercise_time: Start time of the first valve; each further valve follows 10 minutes later.

abort.already_configured: Danfoss Ally Coordinator is already configured.
abort.no_supported_rooms: No area with a supported ZHA Danfoss eTRV0103 and required control entities was found.

refresh.name: Refresh discovery and synchronization
refresh.description: Rediscover sources in the configured areas and evaluate them immediately. Zigbee writes occur only when synchronization is explicitly enabled.

calibrate_local_sensor.name: Calibrate a valve's local temperature sensor
calibrate_local_sensor.description: Once, apply a bounded local offset from fresh room sensors and a freshly reported valve temperature. Refused in covered-radiator mode.

entity_id.name: Danfoss valve
entity_id.description: Climate entity of a valve in a configured room.

incomplete_valve.title: {valve} in {area} is not coordinated
incomplete_valve.description:
ZHA does not provide the control entities this integration needs for the Danfoss valve {valve} ({area}): {missing}. The valve is shown but never written.

Fix: if an entity is disabled, enable it. Otherwise open Settings → Devices & services → ZHA → {valve}, choose ⋮ → Reconfigure, then restart Home Assistant. This happens when ZHA marked the valve's Danfoss attributes as unsupported during pairing.
